threads.reply: Fixed: `runEventLoop` now takes one required `session.snapshot` per attempt and passes `paneIDs` into `subscribeAndForward` (no `try?`, no second snapshot). Snapshot failure fails the attempt so reconnect retries instead of subscribing without pane-scoped `pane.agent_status_changed`.
Also covered: new `paneUpserted` IDs force reconnect so `pane.agent_status_changed` is resubscribed from a fresh snapshot.
Fixed: `applyParentMapEvents` is now keyed by `attachmentID` and mutates `stateByAttachment[attachmentID].parentMap` (public `parentMap` only mirrors the last touched attachment for tests).
Fixed: empty splits are rejected in `RemoteHerdrLayoutNode.decodeChildren`, and `RemoteHerdrImpose.join`/`binaryTree`/`plan` return `nil` instead of synthesizing `.leaf(paneID: "")`.
Fixed: renamed the local to `measuredFirstExtent` so it no longer shadows the static `firstExtent(...)` helper.
Fixed: decoder now rejects empty `horizontal`/`vertical` child arrays; impose path never emits an empty pane id.
